description:
A graph spec that monitors a rotating machine's vibration: waveform, spectrum, RMS, crest
        factor, learned baseline, alarms and a historian, with a dashboard. Starts on a simulated
        signal; replace the source with the real sensor node. Advisory only, no equipment output.
        Example: compose_vibration_monitoring(asset_path="Plant/Line1/Pump3", sample_rate_hz=2048, shaft_rpm=1480, alarm_rms=4.5).

alarm_crest.description: Crest factor (peak / RMS) that raises an alarm.
alarm_crest.title: Alarm Crest

alarm_residual.description: Deviation from the learned baseline that raises an alarm.
alarm_residual.title: Alarm Residual

alarm_rms.description: RMS vibration level that raises an alarm, in the signal's units.
alarm_rms.title: Alarm Rms

asset_path.description: Asset hierarchy path of the monitored machine, e.g. Plant/Line/Pump.
asset_path.title: Asset Path

baseline_alpha.description: Smoothing factor of the baseline, 0 to 1 (smaller adapts more slowly).
baseline_alpha.title: Baseline Alpha

baseline_deviation.description: Allowed deviation from the baseline, in standard deviations.
baseline_deviation.title: Baseline Deviation

shaft_rpm.description: Shaft speed in revolutions per minute, used for the order (1x, 2x) bands.
shaft_rpm.title: Shaft Rpm

signal_amplitude.description: Amplitude of the simulated test signal the graph starts with.
signal_amplitude.title: Signal Amplitude

signal_frequency_hz.description: Frequency of the simulated test signal, in Hz.
signal_frequency_hz.title: Signal Frequency Hz

window_size.description: Samples per analysis window (a power of two is best for the FFT).
window_size.title: Window Size

name: compose_vibration_monitoring
title: Compose vibration condition monitoring
